close_reason: Added unhandled_backend_set_error(&e) helper in helpers.rs. Three call sites in metadata.rs (/set create, update, destroy) collapse to single-line calls. Helper uses {e:?} via Debug bound so the wire description carries the actual variant name — also closes JMAP-826m.36 (actionable variant identification).
description:
What is awkward: metadata.rs:385-393, 449-457, 501-509 — three identical Err(_) arms emit the same:

  json!({
      "type": "serverFail",
      "description": "unhandled backend error variant",
  })

The Err(_) is there because BackendSetError is #[non_exhaustive] (workspace foundation convention). If a future variant is added to BackendSetError and the metadata-server isn't updated, the catch-all fires with this generic message.

Suggested rewrite: factor out a const SERVER_FAIL_UNHANDLED: Value or a fn unhandled_backend_variant() -> Value helper. Three lines of duplicated json! macro is small but adds up when extending to more handlers.

Filing as P3 elegance.
title: handle_metadata_set's three Err(_) catch-alls for 'unhandled backend error variant' duplicate the same json!(...) — single helper would make the catch-all uniform and easier to grep
